questions.e: The shuttle floats in orbit around Aeron, an extinct planet.

questions.q: Why did Viktor land on the planet?
o: The signal matched the one from ten years ago when his father vanished
questions.e: The same frequency as when his father disappeared.

questions.q: Whom did Viktor find in the capsule?
questions.e: In the capsule lay his father, Dr Marko Lazarević.

questions.q: What did the glowing being say about Viktor's father?
o: That he stayed voluntarily to guard the civilization's memory and is happy
questions.e: He chose of his own will to stay and preserve memories.

questions.q: Why did Viktor not wake his father?
o: The old body would not survive the trip, and wanting to bring him back was selfishness
questions.e: His wish to bring him back was his own selfishness.

questions.q: What did Viktor tell ASTRA to do with the data on the underground complex?
o: Keep it, but under the code “Protected by ideals”
